category_policy.Food & Drink: Prepared meals, drinks, cafes, hawkers and food delivery.
category_policy.Groceries: Supermarkets, convenience stores and grocery delivery; merchant default.
category_policy.Transport: Public transit, rides, parking, vehicle rental and fuel; not wallet top-ups.
category_policy.Shopping: Retail, marketplaces, stationery and general bookstores; merchant default.
category_policy.Entertainment: Cinema, concerts, games, leisure attractions and media subscriptions.
category_policy.Bills & Utilities: Phone, internet, electricity, water, gas and identified household bills.
category_policy.Health: Healthcare, medicine and prescription optics; pharmacies default to Health.
category_policy.Education: Tuition and courses; textbooks only when explicitly identified in the input.
category_policy.Other: Identifiable expenses outside these categories, e.g. postage, haircut or donation.
